description: This file defines REST API routes for the carrom game backend, including endpoints for players, games, turns, scores, settings, analytics, and AI moves. It integrates with database models, schemas, game logic, AI engine, and analytics modules, and contains route handlers with detailed logic for game management and interactions.

classes.name: Player
classes.description: Database model representing a player (human or AI) in the game.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Database model representing a game instance, including status and relationships.

classes.name: GamePlayer
classes.description: Associative model linking players to a specific game with scores and turn order.

classes.name: GameSettings
classes.description: Model storing configurable settings for a game instance.

classes.name: Turn
classes.description: Model representing a single move/turn in the game, including position, force, and scoring details.

classes.name: AnalyticsEvent
classes.description: Model for logging analytics events related to game and player interactions.

methods.name: list_players( player_type: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by player type: 'human' or 'ai'"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all registered players, optionally filtered by type (human or AI).

methods.name: get_player(player_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific player by ID.

methods.name: create_player(player_data: PlayerCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new player record, specifying name and type.

methods.name: delete_player(player_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a player from the database.

methods.name: list_games( status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by game status"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists all games with optional filtering by status.

methods.name: get_game(game_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific game, including players and settings.

methods.name: create_game(game_data: GameCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new game instance with specified players and settings.

methods.name: update_game_status( game_id: uuid.UUID, status: str = Query(..., description="New status: 'in_progress', 'completed', 'abandoned'"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Updates the current status of an existing game.

methods.name: delete_game(game_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Removes a game and associated data from the system.

methods.name: list_turns(game_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves all turns made in a game.

methods.name: create_turn( game_id: uuid.UUID, turn_data: TurnCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Submits a new move for a game, processing scoring, fouls, and game state updates.

methods.name: get_scores(game_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches current scores for all players in a game.

methods.name: get_settings(game_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration settings of a game.

methods.name: update_settings( game_id: uuid.UUID, settings_data: GameSettingsUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Modifies the settings for a specific game.

methods.name: create_analytics_event( event_data: AnalyticsEventCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Logs a custom analytics event related to gameplay or players.

methods.name: list_analytics_events( event_type: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by event type"), game_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = Query(None, description="Filter by game ID"), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500, description="Max results to return"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves logged analytics events with optional filters.

methods.name: request_ai_move( move_request: AIMoveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Generates and processes an AI move for the game using heuristics based on difficulty.

methods.name: get_game_state(game_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns the full game state including all turns and current settings for initial synchronization or resuming gameplay.
